scientific_integrity: Analytic argument for all real a >=4 and asymptotic a to infinity; numeric script is a check, not proof. Research assessment is not independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Only endpoint neighborhoods, not a complete phase diagram; sharp sparse asymptotic only on p=1/(2a^4). Unindexed equivalent literature remains possible.
title: Re-entrant strict sub-Gaussianity and sharp sparse-amplitude proxy growth
